### Accessibility and behavior

- A real h3 heading names the panel section
- Subtitle and summary text remain visible beside the heading
- The panel is noninteractive

Role: `none`.

Accessible name: `heading` strategy targeting `h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6`.

| Keyboard input | Declared outcome |
| --- | --- |
| None declared | No component-owned keyboard behavior is declared. |

### Compatibility

Mirrors renderAddressCollectionPanel over renderPanelSection with data-panel-type=address: title aliases title/label/heading/name (default Addresses), subtitle aliases subtitle/description/metadata, and summary/text/body/emptyMessage fill the content area only without authored children. The saved-schema directives roleField, defaultRoleField and roleParameter are consumed by codegen and left unbound, and the generic field (the addresses collection) is consumed without a binding: the HTML renderer reads no address data, so the panel presents its heading, subtitle, summary and authored children only.
